WebSearch confirms the current, active occupant of 4126 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105 is Sayulitas Mexican Food (189 Yelp photos, current hours listed) - no trace of any 'Abierto's Mexican Food' at this address on Yelp, Google, or delivery platforms; the only 'Abiertos Mexican Food' found nationally is an unrelated Uber Eats listing in Salem, OR. This name most likely no longer operates at this address (renamed/replaced by Sayulitas) - treated as permanently not found rather than a temporary access obstacle.

name: Babcock & Story Bar
notes: Own hoteldel.com page embeds a SinglePlatform widget (places.singleplatform.com) that lists item names/descriptions but prices only 1 of ~45 items (a seasonal special) - below the 5-priced-item threshold, so not usable as the source. Address matches work-list exactly (1500 Orange Ave, Coronado, CA 92118). Sections combine group + category, e.g. 'Bar Drink Menu / Wine'.
